$comment: Acknowledged baseline of current SSOT-projection orphans. Guarded by tests/Hypermedia/SsotProjectionAuditTest.php. The audit walks alps.json <-> src/Resource <-> var/templates in three directions; anything that does not project cleanly MUST appear here with a category, reason and evidence. The test demands an EXACT match: a NEW orphan fails the test (add it here or fix it); a baseline entry that now projects cleanly fails the test (it was fixed -> remove it here). The bug-category entries (naming-mismatch / missing-alps-descriptor / missing-write-handler) are the live punch-list; framework-internal / js-only are permanent-by-design. See docs/eccube-spec-coverage/skipped-operations.json for the sibling op-coverage registry (every do* op is covered by a flow test or skipped there).

categories.framework-internal: Router/fallback descriptor, not an EC-CUBE domain affordance; legitimately absent from alps.json (ActionRedirect / UnsupportedRoute / EmptyPage).
categories.naming-mismatch: BUG: the resource #[Alps('...')] id does not exist in alps.json, but an equivalent descriptor does under a different id. Fix the resource to use the existing alps id.
categories.missing-alps-descriptor: BUG: the affordance is referenced by a resource and/or template but has NO descriptor in alps.json (the SSOT). Add the descriptor to alps.json, or collapse the reference onto an existing one.
categories.missing-write-handler: BUG: a no-JS write <form> submits to a resource that has no matching write handler (onPost/onPut/onDelete). Submitting it reaches a non-existent method and leaks a raw weaved-class string (the CustomerDeliveryEdit class of bug). Add the handler, repoint the action, or convert the form to GET.
categories.js-only: The <form> is driven by JS/AJAX (buttons are type=button + data-action, or a bare <button> wired to data-action); the no-JS harness never submits it, so the onGet-only resource is not actually reached by a real no-JS POST.

doActionRedirect.reason: Storefront internal action-redirect dispatch page; not a domain affordance.

doAdminActionRedirect.reason: Admin internal action-redirect dispatch page; not a domain affordance.

doUnsupportedRoute.reason: Storefront fallback for unmigrated routes; router internal.

doAdminUnsupportedRoute.reason: Admin fallback for unmigrated routes; router internal.

Page/Admin/ProductList.reason: The form_bulk action="" wraps JS bulk operations: the status buttons are type=button + data-action (doBulkUpdateProductStatus), and one bare <button> should also be type=button. No no-JS submit actually reaches ProductList in a real browser flow.
